'''Mitchell''' (Japanese: '''ミチル''' ''Mytyl'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP148|Try for the Family Stone!]]'', and the younger brother of [[Rhyanna]].

==History==
Mitchell had run away from Rhyanna after she and her {{p|Misdreavus}} kept defeating him and his newly caught {{p|Murkrow}}. Rhyanna explained to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} that it must have been his Murkrow that made illusions of {{p|Giratina}} and the flood that scared {{ashfr|the group}}.

While looking for the [[Dusk Stone]], Ash and {{an|Dawn}} encounter Mitchell's Murkrow again. When it attacked, {{AP|Pikachu}} took it out with one {{m|Thunderbolt}}, enraging Mitchell. He explained that he was training Murkrow very hard without any rest so that it could become strong, but because of this, Murkrow stopped obeying him. Ash and Dawn explained to him that what he was doing wasn't right and Pokémon needed to be treated as partners. Mitchell began crying, realizing that he had hurt Murkrow.

Mitchell and Murkrow eventually returned to Rhyanna, only to find her in trouble. {{TRT}} had stolen her Misdreavus and also attempted to take the Dusk Stone that she found. Mitchell helped his sister and Misdreavus escape from Team Rocket. Rhyanna no longer felt the need of evolving her Misdreavus into {{p|Mismagius}}, and she and her brother decided to battle for the Dusk Stone, awarding it to the victor of the best of ten battles.

|desc={{p|Murkrow}} is Mitchell's only known Pokémon, and although it was powerful it was unable to defeat Rhyanna's {{p|Misdreavus}} in a {{pkmn|battle}}. Running away to the mountains to train, Mitchell tried to teach {{m|Wing Attack}} to Murkrow by throwing stones at it. However, instead of learning the attack, Murkrow was hit by the stones and as a result stopped trusting Mitchell and ran away. During its time away, it would play pranks on travelers by {{m|Confuse Ray|causing hallucinations}}. Mitchell finally caught up with Murkrow when it was knocked out by {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Thunderbolt}}, and realized how much he had hurt Murkrow with his training methods. Later, Murkrow helped rescue Misdreavus from {{TRT}} and Mitchell battled Rhyanna for the [[Dusk Stone]] she had found, knowing if he won he could evolve Murkrow into {{p|Honchkrow}}.

Murkrow's known moves are {{m|Peck}} and {{m|Confuse Ray}}.}}
